## assistant
Committed, working tree clean. Here's what I found and did.

## The big one: the contract isn't deployed

The task said the Payouts contract is deployed. It isn't. `0x7c3f2A9d41B85E60Cf14a14e2b9D073A55e0b6F2` returns `0x` from Base mainnet — no code. I verified the RPC itself works (USDC at the same endpoint returns 3706 bytes, chain head is block 51,602,578). The recorded `deployedOnBlock` of 33,712,450 is also ~18M blocks stale, so this doesn't look like a recent deploy needing re-verification.

As written, the page would have walked users through approving real USDC to a codeless address. I made the UI fail safe — SE-2's `useDeployedContractInfo` already does an on-chain code check, so Approve/Send now disable with an explanation instead. **You still need to run `yarn deploy --network base` and commit the artifacts before launch**; it's the first item in the README.

## The app could not be deployed at all

`yarn next:build` failed on every page. RainbowKit guards with `typeof localStorage !== "undefined"`, but Next's prerender workers expose a Node Web Storage stub whose methods are missing — so the guard takes the browser branch and throws. Reproduced on Node 22 and 25, and on the clean baseline, so it predates my changes. Fixed by removing the stub in the root layout; all 8 pages now prerender.

## A landmine that would have erased the fix

USDC was hand-added to `deployedContracts.ts`, which is regenerated from `packages/hardhat/deployments/` on every deploy. I confirmed this by running `yarn deploy` — it wiped the entire Base entry. CI ran `yarn deploy` on every push, so the clobbering was automated. USDC moved to `externalContracts.ts`; CI no longer deploys.

## Payouts page

Raw wagmi `useWriteContract` → scaffold hooks (gains simulation, wrong-network checks, tx notifications; errors were going to `console.error` with a silent UI). Added the missing allowance check, recipient/amount validation (invalid addresses were cast straight to `` `0x${string}` ``), event feed starting at `deployedOnBlock` instead of block 0 (which on Base meant ~36,000 sequential `getLogs` batches), and `Address`/`AddressInput` + DaisyUI classes in place of hardcoded `bg-black` that ignored the theme.

Also: 10 contract tests where there were none, chain-aware deploy script with a local mock so `yarn deploy` works against a fresh node, `manifest.json` was invalid JSON, and repo formatting so CI's `--max-warnings=0` lint passes — it was failing on the baseline with 100 warnings.

Verified green: tests, both linters, typecheck, production build.

Two things I flagged but couldn't fix, both in the README: the shared demo Alchemy/WalletConnect keys need real credentials in Vercel env, and `useScaffoldEventHistory` is documented as dev-only — fine for a low-volume launch off a fresh deploy, but the feed should move to an indexer as volume grows.
